recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-46005; any separate desire to refresh checked-in resource SVGs should use the normal generation process.
issue_request: FHIR-46005 was an Applied/Persuasive PA change request for R6 asking that Patient.deceased be described as a date of death or death status rather than only as a boolean. The approved resolution set the definition to indicate the date when the individual died or, if unknown/cannot be estimated, a flag that the patient is known to be deceased, with short display "Indicates if/when the individual is deceased".
initial_application: The requested source change was already applied by commit 5c7031e3d470da172746e2b54a3657c27e306996, which replaced the old boolean-only short display and definition in source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml. The combined branch contains that application commit.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists patient=Patient in the active [resources] section, confirming the Patient StructureDefinition is in build scope. Later same-element issue FHIR-53438 was Resolved - No Change and cited the current short display as sufficiently clear. A repository search found the old Patient wording only in source/patient/patient.svg, a generated-looking SVG tooltip, and in Person.deceased, which is a separate boolean-only element.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. The authoritative Patient StructureDefinition already matches the FHIR-46005 resolution, and editing only the checked-in SVG artifact would not be an appropriate source fix.

related_jiras.note: Later PA no-change decision about Patient.deceasedDateTime future dates confirms the current short display is considered clear and does not require a wording or constraint change.
